findings_addressed.action: Enclosed Stream and Utf8JsonWriter in explicit nested await using scopes within SaveAsync to guarantee proper disposal and disk flush ordering, preventing file handle leaks and Windows sharing lock violations (ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION).

Validated MoveToMainFolderAsync destination routing to canonical PluginStoragePartitions.Incoming partition, preventing assembly isolation in loaded partition. Enriched method with complete XML documentation.

Enforced CultureInfo.InvariantCulture across all double.Parse coordinate invocations in Parse and TryParse, and standardized ToString with invariant formatting. Added comprehensive XML documentation and created test/UnitTests/Mathematics/Models/Vector3DTests.cs.

output_summary: Successfully implemented and validated Phase 1 portability zero-risk hotfixes across MelloSilveiraTools.Plugins and MelloSilveiraTools.Mathematics. Eliminated stream scoping leaks in JsonFilePluginCachePersistence, verified canonical partition relocation in PluginFileProcessor, and enforced invariant culture parsing in Vector3D with full test coverage.
justification_for_decisions:
1. In JsonFilePluginCachePersistence.SaveAsync, explicit nested await using blocks ensure Utf8JsonWriter flushes and disposes before the underlying stream is flushed and closed, guaranteeing zero file locking latency on Windows.
2. In PluginFileProcessor.MoveToMainFolderAsync, routing to PluginStoragePartitions.Incoming adheres to the storage-agnostic partition topology, allowing plugins to re-enter the discovery pipeline.
3. In Vector3D, passing CultureInfo.InvariantCulture prevents catastrophic parsing corruption or FormatException in locales where comma is the decimal separator (e.g., pt-BR, de-DE), aligning with Point3D conventions.
4. Both libraries compile cleanly with zero errors under .NET 10 without violating C# 13 conventions (no var, explicit types, collection expressions).
